hook.en: Your body remembers. After one encounter with a pathogen, the immune system responds faster and stronger the next time.

body.en: *Innate immunity* is non-specific and present at birth. It has four types of barriers. Physical barriers: skin, and mucus coating the respiratory, gastrointestinal and urogenital tracts. Physiological barriers: acid in the stomach, saliva in the mouth, and tears from the eyes. Cellular barriers: leukocytes such as polymorpho-nuclear leukocytes (PMNL-neutrophils), monocytes and natural killer lymphocytes, and macrophages, which phagocytose microbes. Cytokine barriers: virus-infected cells secrete interferons, which protect non-infected cells from further viral infection.
body.kn: ಸಹಜ ಪ್ರತಿರಕ್ಷೆ ಹುಟ್ಟಿನಿಂದಲೇ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ ಮತ್ತು ನಿರ್ದಿಷ್ಟವಲ್ಲ. ಭೌತಿಕ (ಚರ್ಮ, ಲೋಳೆ), ಶಾರೀರಿಕ (ಜಠರದ ಆಮ್ಲ, ಲಾಲಾರಸ, ಕಣ್ಣೀರು), ಕೋಶೀಯ (ನ್ಯೂಟ್ರೋಫಿಲ್, ಮೊನೊಸೈಟ್, NK ಕೋಶಗಳು) ಮತ್ತು ಸೈಟೋಕಿನ್ (ಇಂಟರ್‌ಫೆರಾನ್) ತಡೆಗಳು.

say.en: Physiological: stomach acid, saliva, tears.
Cellular: neutrophils, monocytes, NK cells, macrophages.
Cytokine: interferons.
Innate immunity is non-specific and present from birth. It has four kinds of barriers: physical, physiological, cellular and cytokine.
Acquired immunity is specific. B cells make antibodies, each with two heavy and two light chains, H2L2. Types include IgA, IgM, IgE and IgG.
The first meeting with a pathogen gives a weak primary response. The second gives a fast, strong secondary response, because memory cells remember it.
T cells help B cells and give cell-mediated immunity, which is why transplanted organs can be rejected.
Board: innate and acquired immunity.

body.en: *Acquired immunity* is pathogen-specific and has memory. The first encounter gives a low-intensity primary response; a later encounter gives a highly intensified secondary or anamnestic response. B-lymphocytes make antibodies (humoral immunity, in the blood and lymph); T-lymphocytes help B cells and mediate cell-mediated immunity (CMI), which is responsible for graft rejection. Each antibody has four peptide chains, two light and two heavy (H₂L₂). Types of antibodies include IgA, IgM, IgE and IgG.
body.kn: ಗಳಿಸಿದ ಪ್ರತಿರಕ್ಷೆ ರೋಗಕಾರಕ-ನಿರ್ದಿಷ್ಟ ಮತ್ತು ನೆನಪು ಹೊಂದಿದೆ. B-ಲಿಂಫೋಸೈಟ್‌ಗಳು ಪ್ರತಿಕಾಯಗಳನ್ನು ತಯಾರಿಸುತ್ತವೆ; T-ಲಿಂಫೋಸೈಟ್‌ಗಳು ಕೋಶ-ಮಧ್ಯಸ್ಥ ಪ್ರತಿರಕ್ಷೆಗೆ ಕಾರಣ. ಪ್ರತಿಕಾಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಎರಡು ಹಗುರ ಮತ್ತು ಎರಡು ಭಾರ ಸರಪಳಿಗಳು (H₂L₂).

problem.en: A kidney transplanted from an unrelated donor is rejected even though the patient was healthy. Which part of the immune system is responsible, and why is tissue matching done?

steps.en: The body recognises the graft as 'non-self'.
T-lymphocytes mount a cell-mediated immune response against it: graft rejection.
Tissue and blood-group matching reduces the difference, and immunosuppressants are given lifelong.

answer.en: Cell-mediated immunity by T-lymphocytes; matching and immunosuppressants reduce rejection
